name: "Spyglass" Aim Assist
description: this mech does One thing and it is hit things. if it doesnt hit things it feels bad. hence, make it easier to hit things.
effect: The weapon this mod is applied to gains +1 Accuracy.

actions.name: Collimate
actions.detail: On a hit with the weapon this mod is applied to, you may expend a charge as a free action to apply Lock On to the target.

name: Harmonic Oscillator
description: wouldnt it be sooo silly if we could use quicken spell on lancer weapons? anyway this is my equivalent to saladin, another supporty mech, having access to a crazy dps weapon mod
effect: The weapon this mod is applied to gains Loading. Gain Raise the Pendulum.

actions.name: Raise the Pendulum
actions.detail: For the rest of the current turn, if the weapon this mod is applied to is a superheavy weapon, you may attack with it as a Skirmish. If it is any other size, you may attack with it as a free action.
